family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s and a list of integer indices, return s with the characters at those positions removed (referring to positions in the original string). Indices may be given in any order, may repeat, and any index outside the valid range of s is simply ignored.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, return a copy of s with its first and last characters swapped with each other. If s has 0 or 1 characters, return it unchanged.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s and a single character ch, find the first occurrence of ch in s, remove it from that position, and reinsert it at the very front of the string, leaving all other characters in their relative order. If ch does not occur in s, return s unchanged.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, a single character ch, and a positive integer n, return the index of the nth occurrence (1-indexed) of ch in s, scanning left to right. Return -1 if ch occurs fewer than n times in s, including when s is empty.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, a single character ch, a positive integer n, and a replacement string, replace the nth occurrence (1-indexed) of ch in s with replacement, leaving every other character unchanged, and return the result. If ch occurs fewer than n times, return s unchanged.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s and a single character ch, find all positions where ch occurs in s and return a list of the gaps (index differences) between each pair of consecutive occurrences, in order. If ch occurs fewer than two times, return an empty list.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, return True if for every valid position i, the character at position i is equal to the character at position i+2 (the string repeats with a period of 2 when comparing characters two apart). Strings of length 0, 1, or 2 always satisfy this and return True.
reference:
def is_every_other_char_same(s):
    return all(s[i] == s[i + 2] for i in range(len(s) - 2))

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, return the number of distinct characters that appear anywhere in s, regardless of how many times each one repeats. An empty string returns 0.
reference:
def count_distinct_characters(s):
    return len(set(s))

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, a target width, and a single fill character fillchar, center s within a field of the given width using fillchar for padding. If the padding needed cannot be split evenly between both sides, the extra fill character goes on the right side. If width is less than or equal to the length of s, return s unchanged.
reference:
def pad_string_center(s, width, fillchar):
    if width <= len(s):
        return s
    total_pad = width - len(s)
    left = total_pad // 2
    right = total_pad - left
    return fillchar * left + s + fillchar * right

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s and an integer max_len (at least 3), if s is longer than max_len characters, truncate it and append an ellipsis '...' so that the returned string has exactly max_len characters in total; otherwise return s unchanged.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, return True if it is valid kebab-case: made up only of lowercase letters and digits grouped into non-empty segments separated by single hyphens, with no leading or trailing hyphen and no two consecutive hyphens. Return False for an empty string or any string violating these rules (such as containing uppercase letters, spaces, or other punctuation).

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, return True if it is valid snake_case: made up only of lowercase letters and digits grouped into non-empty segments separated by single underscores, with no leading or trailing underscore and no two consecutive underscores. Return False for an empty string or any string violating these rules (such as containing uppercase letters, spaces, or other punctuation).

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s made of words separated by underscores and/or spaces, convert it to kebab-case: lowercase every letter and replace each run of one or more underscores or spaces with a single hyphen; leading and trailing separators are removed entirely.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a camelCase or PascalCase string s, convert it to snake_case by inserting an underscore before each uppercase letter (except when it is the very first character of the string) and lowercasing every letter.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, return a dictionary mapping each distinct character that appears in s to a list of every index (in ascending order) at which it occurs. An empty string returns an empty dictionary.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, count the number of maximal runs of consecutive digit characters in s (any non-digit character ends the current run and does not itself count). A string with no digits returns 0.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given two strings a and b, return True if there is a one-to-one character mapping from a to b such that replacing every occurrence of each character in a with its mapped character produces b exactly, and the mapping is consistent in both directions. Strings of different lengths are never isomorphic and return False.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, return True if s is non-empty and its first character is identical to its last character (a single-character string always satisfies this since it is its own first and last character). Return False for an empty string.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s and a substring sub, count the number of non-overlapping occurrences of sub in s, ignoring case differences between letters when matching. If sub is an empty string, return 0.

family: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
spec: Given a string s, count the number of maximal contiguous groups of characters that share the same class, where the three classes are letters, digits, and everything else (such as punctuation or spaces). An empty string returns 0.
